guards.condition: tenant_id resolves to active tenant
guards.failure_behavior: deny write/read or read-only by policy

guards.condition: actor tenant context matches target tenant_id
Core grants entitlement/consent/runtime access
guards.applies_to: member delivery, assignment activation, sensitive reads
guards.failure_behavior: deny by default if Core unavailable

guards.condition: all canonical refs valid or allowed warning
journey_version status is published
provider confirms payment_succeeded reference
agreement signed/waived/not required
assignment active and not blocked/revoked
enrollment activated or in_progress
step available/started and unlock rules satisfied
notification consent and quiet-hours allow send
tenant feature flag enables capability
reflection/message visible to actor by policy
actor has moderator role for space
command/webhook idempotency key unique or replay-safe
domain mutation and outbox insert occur in one transaction
retry count below max and next_attempt_at due
projection rebuild writes checkpoint after complete replay
support replay has approved scope, reason, operator
events/audit avoid raw PII and sensitive content
